denial_reason: The records submitted do not document a prior lumbar spine X-ray.

docs.author: Dr. Noor Haddad
sentences: Patient is a 66-year-old woman with low back pain for about two months.
No fever, weight loss, saddle numbness or cancer history.
Lumbar X-rays on 2026-07-01 showed mild degenerative change.
Works as a school bus driver.
Symptoms persist after more than two months of physical therapy and daily naproxen.
Plan: MRI of the lumbar spine without contrast.
docs.title: Orthopedic clinic visit note

payer_letter: Harborline Medicare Advantage has reviewed claim A-1002 for MRI of the lumbar spine. Coverage requires documentation of a prior lumbar spine X-ray together with at least six weeks of conservative treatment, or a red flag condition. The records submitted do not document a prior lumbar spine X-ray. You may request reconsideration within 60 days of this notice.
